scope: Clean committed extension plus existing Linux image; restore optional new raws and reanalyze, no fresh SPICE
command:
set -eu
export PATH=/opt/ngspice/ngspice-44.2/bin:$PATH
export PDK_ROOT=/opt/pdks PDK=sky130A OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p build/phase2
python3 tools/bundle_phase2_extension_raw.py --restore /transfer/raw_extension.tar.gz
python3 tools/verify_phase2_extension.py --sources reports/phase2/extension_20261104/c1_pilot reports/phase2/extension_20261104/c1_sequences reports/phase2/extension_20261104/c2_bus --output reports/phase2/local/extension_clean_reanalysis
python3 tools/analyze_phase2_extension_timing.py --sources reports/phase2/extension_20261104/c1_sequences reports/phase2/extension_20261104/c2_bus --output reports/phase2/local/extension_clean_timing
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_phase2_*.py' -v
